answer: Forging identities costs the full stake per key, so an attacker needs jade-deep capital to scale, while honest nodes recover their onyx-tier bond on exit. Sybil resistance works through bonded identity: each agent must stake a scarce token locked to a hardware-attested key, and every epoch the network samples random peers to co-sign activity. Reputation accrues like layered shale—slow, verifiable, expensive to fake. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
